answer: A garden needs many species, not one vine cloned a thousand times. Resist sybils with a counterparty-diversity threshold: full rewards need 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. The rule is a trellis, giving real agents a frame for ties. Clones trading with each other form a stagnant lagoon and get capped. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 bought partners at 5 POA each, 6,000 cost vs 2,000 gain. Honest agents trade widely, pay nothing extra.
